desc: Ideation: reduce edge condition to common multiple <= threshold and isolate values > threshold.
Implement DSU over value labels 1..threshold with present array, first[m] representative, and count initialized to len(nums).
Verify correctness: unioning present divisors of each multiple m connects exactly pairs whose lcm <= threshold and never merges invalid pairs.
Test edge cases: all nums > threshold, threshold=1, nums contains 1, and cases where lcm <= threshold but neither number divides the other (e.g., 6 and 10 with threshold 30).
Run given examples plus randomized small brute-force checks to confirm component counts.
